GOLDEN TOMMY GUN.description: SAY HELLO TO MY LITTLE FRIEND.
GOLDEN TOMMY GUN.name: GOLDEN TOMMY GUN

FAL PARA SHORTY.description: A heavily customized FAL 50.63, and as such has battle rifle characteristics. Has an incredibly short barrel, leading to poor recoil management and equally poor range.
FAL PARA SHORTY.name: FAL PARA SHORTY

SCAR PDW.description:
A carbine variant of the MK16 SOCOM. Slow rate of fire, but has very strong close range performance and snappy weapon handling.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
SCAR PDW.name: SCAR PDW

MP5.description: Famous for its police and near-ubiquitous media usage, the SMX-9 is an Eisenmarkian submachine gun favored for its size. Though specializing in very little, the SMX-9 is a jack of all trades with good damage, good recoil, good RPM, and good handling.
MP5.name: MP5

HK416C.description:
A PDW variant of the Eisenmarkian M416, rumoured to have been made specifically for Soveran Air Service for their subcompact carbine needs.
Has good handling with mobility and optimal damage counteracted by slower fire rate and smaller initial magazine capacity.
''This might actually be the world's most boring job.''

Model submitted by Rialag.
HK416C.name: HK416C

KRINKOV.description: A extra short Kalashnikov weapon firing the 5.45x39mm cartridge. Fires much faster than the standard Kalashnikov automatic, and reloads at lightning fast speeds. It is also considered a Krinkov, a nickname given to extra short barreled AK's in the Grand Federation market.
KRINKOV.name: KRINKOV

L2A3.description: The L2A3, otherwise known as the Sterling, is a PDW that was intended to replace the aging Sten gun in Soveran service. Slower RPM for its class and a pistol cartridge mean the SMG features good recoil and good up close damage.
L2A3.name: L2A3

MP40.description: The progenitor to a variety of modern SMGs, the MP40 is a famous, vintage Great War Eisenmarkian submachine gun. Its relatively slow RPM and smaller cartridge lends itself to incredibly controllable recoil and decent ranged performance.
MP40.name: MP40

MP5SD.description: The SMX-9SD is a specialized, integrally suppressed version of the SMX-9. Desired for its great suppressor and quiet operation, the SMX-9SD boasts impressive point-blank damage for a 9x19mm SMG with low recoil, and poor ranged performance.
MP5SD.name: MP5SD

MP5/10.description: The SMX-9/10 was a response to a desire from police forces to utilize a cartridge larger than the SMX-9's regular 9x19mm. Chambered in 10mm Auto, the SMX-9/10 has fantastic damage point-blank and impressive damage range retention. It suffers from poor recoil as a result of its retooling into 10mm.
MP5/10.name: MP5/10

FAMAS COMMANDO.description:
A rare short-barrelled version of the Lysorian FAMAS G2 intended for international exports but saw no international interest.
Only a few prototypes exist of this gun and how it performs is largely unknown.
It has the fastest fire rate but struggles with recoil and quick damage drop off.
Burst fire reduces recoil by 20% and increases RPM by 100!

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
FAMAS COMMANDO.name: FAMAS COMMANDO

MP5K.description: The SMX-9K is a subcompact, lightweight version of the SMX-9 that looks straight out of a spy movie. Aided by its mobility, it packs a real punch up close and has the low recoil necessary for a decent range.
MP5K.name: MP5K

RAMA 1130.description: The RAMA 1130 is a prototypical, fully automatic conversion of the Makarov by the Zarovian Academy of Rocket and Artillery Sciences (RAMA). Never leaving the prototype stage, the RAMA is a bullet-hose featuring high RPM and high magazine capacity.
RAMA 1130.name: RAMA 1130
